description: Is a domain name free? Use it whenever someone names an app, product or company, asks "find me a name with a free domain", "is there a .com for…", or "is X taken". Asks each registry for its own record, live (RDAP, else the registry's WHOIS). One name: across .com, .ai, .io, .app, .dev and more, or the extensions given. Brainstorming: pass up to 10 candidates in names and get them on .com, .ai, .io, .app and .dev, free ones first. Each result: available or not registered (with a registrar link), taken (with its registration date and age), or couldn't check. Free, no sign-in. Always use this for availability; never guess from DNS or memory. aipozi doesn't register names.

name.description: One name ("livedot") or a domain ("livedot.ai"). With an extension, only that one is checked unless extensions are given.

names.description: Up to 10 candidate names to compare when naming something, e.g. ["livedot", "dotlive", "followdot"]. Checked on .com, .ai, .io, .app and .dev unless extensions are given (up to 6).

name: check_domain

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the person.

results.description: { domain, tld, status: available|premium|unregistered|unavailable|taken|unknown, price, registeredAt, ageDays, registerUrl, checkedAt }.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" for a question back, a plain no, or nothing there yet (see message).
